title_zh: 核对虚构戏剧中的监禁时间线

scenario.label_zh: 核对虚构戏剧中的监禁时间线
scenario.goal_zh: 依据剧情确定角色仍未获释，并商定修正场景转换字幕

context_zh: 编剧与剧本编辑审阅一部完全虚构的宫廷戏；其中的监禁命令仅为剧情设定。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: In scene two, the king orders the guards to imprison Lio for a year. Why is Lio free in the next scene?

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: He is not. That scene takes place in the prison courtyard, six months into his imprisonment.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: The transition card says he is back at home. That is what confused me.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Then the card is wrong. The release happens in the final act, after the year has passed.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: I'll change this card to: prison courtyard, six months later.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Yes. That preserves the sequence without changing the scenes themselves.
